agents.title: Agents
agents.body: Each agent is one job with its own cadence, channels and steering. They share the workspace's intelligence and never book the same slot twice.

status.body: When on, Contivo ideates, drafts and schedules posts for you on a cadence — no clicks. Publishing happens automatically when each slot arrives.

warnings.ideation: This workspace can't ideate yet. Autopilot needs Brand Memory, Market Matrices and Competitor Keywords — run those tabs first. Runs will be skipped until then.
warnings.channels: None of the selected channels can publish yet. Social channels need a connected default account and Blog needs a website — set one up on the <link>Connections</link> page, or Autopilot will skip every run.

form.postsPerWeekHint: Autopilot keeps the coming 7 days topped up to this number.
form.timezoneHint: IANA name. Publish window and days are interpreted in this zone.
form.channelsHint: Green dot = that channel can actually publish (social account or website connected).
form.windowHint: e.g. 9 to 18 = posts land between 09:00 and 17:59.
form.storylinesHint: All of them unless you narrow it. The runner rotates across whichever are selected, so one claim is not repeated week after week.
form.themesPlaceholder: e.g. AI adoption for SMEs, founder lessons, product updates
form.themesHint: Comma or newline separated. Passed to the AI as steering.
form.avoidHint: Ideas whose topic contains any of these phrases are dropped.
form.requireReviewOff: Off: drafts that pass the quality checks publish on schedule.
form.requireReviewOn: On: every draft waits for you in the pipeline until you approve it.

narrative.title: This agent is publishing without a narrative.
narrative.body: It still runs, and nothing here is blocked. But its posts are not laddering up to anything, so they will not add up over a month.

write.intro: Your text, saved as Ready and never rewritten. Schedule it like any other post. An optional image is the only part that costs credits.

brandMemory.title: Brand Foundation & Knowledge Layer
brandMemory.body: This section keeps your brand context stable across strategy, content, and design. AI drafts the first version from your website, then your team confirms and improves it.

quality.heldNote: Held: it won't publish until it passes or you choose Publish anyway.
quality.overriddenNote: You chose to publish this without passing the check.
quality.error: The check couldn't run. Try again.
quality.previewPassed: This draft passed the quality check.
quality.previewFailed: This draft didn't pass the quality check. You can still add it to the Pipeline, but it won't publish until it passes or you choose Publish anyway.

dialog.title: Publish without passing the quality check?
dialog.body: The quality check held this draft back because:
dialog.note: If you continue, you can schedule and publish it like any other post. We record that you chose to publish it anyway.

reasons.platform_char_limit: It's longer than this platform allows.
reasons.word_count: It's too short or too long for this platform.
reasons.leakage: It still has template placeholders or assistant chatter in it.
reasons.avoid_list: It mentions a phrase you asked us to avoid.
reasons.duplicate: It repeats a post you published or scheduled recently.
reasons.unavailable: The quality check couldn't run, so nobody has reviewed this text.
reasons.judge_veto: The reviewer judged it unsafe to publish: it may make claims you can't back up, give medical, legal or financial advice, or read as machine-written.
reasons.not_checked: The text changed after it was checked, so this version hasn't been reviewed.
reasons.brandFit: It doesn't sound like your brand (score {score, number}/{max, number}).
reasons.factualSafety: It makes claims nobody can verify (score {score, number}/{max, number}).
reasons.clarity: It isn't clear or finished enough (score {score, number}/{max, number}).
reasons.storylineFit: It doesn't move your storyline forward (score {score, number}/{max, number}).
reasons.evidenceDiscipline: It leans on proof you haven't given us (score {score, number}/{max, number}).
reasons.low_score: It scored below the bar on the reviewer's checks.
reasons.other: It didn't pass one of the quality checks.
